title: DinkData event log v1 (events.json)
description: One game: who played, and every rally with its hits and bounces. Made by pipeline/events (Partner B) with Partner A's bounces; read by stats/ and later the app. Stat definitions: docs/STATS.md. Court coordinates: docs/COURT.md. Rules JSON Schema can't express are listed under $comment.
$comment: Also required, checked in code: player ids are unique; rally and event ids are unique in the file; every `server` and hit `player` is a listed player id; within a rally, events are sorted by `t` and every `t` is between `start_frame` and `end_frame`; rallies are sorted by `start_frame` and don't overlap. Human corrections are stored as a separate patch file that refers to rally and event ids, never by editing this file.

schema.description: Format and version of this file. A breaking change bumps the version.

id.description: Opaque video id. Never a player name, location or original file name.

court.description: Which calibration produced the court positions. The homography itself lives in court.json.

camera_id.description: The camera_id of the court.json used.

players.description: Everyone on court: 4 for doubles, 2 for singles.

tracks.description: Where the per-frame tracks for this video are stored (URIs or paths).

frame.description: Frame index in the video, from 0.

conf.description: Model confidence, 0 to 1. Human-entered events use 1.

label.description: Display name. Generic ('Player 1') unless the player has agreed to more.

track_ids.description: Tracker ids in players.parquet that belong to this player.

server_number.description: 1 or 2 in doubles. Singles always uses 1.

score_before.description: Score called before the serve: serving-team-receiving-team-server, e.g. '4-3-2'. Singles omits the server number: '4-3'.

winner_team.description: Team that won the rally. null when the pipeline can't tell; review fills it in.

end_reason.description: Why the ball died. net: last shot didn't cross the net. out: first bounce after the last shot was out. double_bounce: the ball bounced twice on one side. unreturned: a player touched it but didn't get it back over. fault: any other rule fault (e.g. two-bounce rule, kitchen volley). null when unknown.

reviewed.description: true once a person has checked this rally.

player.description: Who hit it. null when the hit is detected but not attributed.

shot.description: serve and return are shots 1 and 2. Later shots are classified as drop, drive, lob, dink or speedup (docs/STATS.md), or other. null until the shot classifier exists.

volley.description: true if hit before the ball bounced on the hitter's side.

court_xy.description: Bounce position in court feet (docs/COURT.md). Can be outside 0-20 x 0-44 for out balls.

in.description: Inside the court, or for a serve's first bounce, inside the correct service court. A serve on the kitchen line is not in.

close_call.description: Within the close-call distance of a line (docs/COURT.md > Zones). Goes to review instead of being trusted.
